project-board.label: Project Board
project-board.blurb: The Project Board provides senior oversight of the Housing Digital Transformation programme. It is responsible for strategic direction, prioritisation, and decisions on investment, resources, and escalation.

steering-group.label: Steering Group
steering-group.blurb: The Steering Group brings together service leadership to review progress, surface operational issues, and advise the Project Board so that decisions are informed by service-wide knowledge.

technical-group.label: Technical Group
technical-group.blurb: The Technical Group provides specialist advice on information technology, systems architecture, and data. It meets as required when technical detail is needed to support design or delivery decisions.

business-group.label: Business Group
business-group.blurb: The Business Group draws on specialist expertise from across the Council. It meets as required to inform business requirements and the impact of change on services.
